# Trellis

> Trellis provides authenticated, contract-defined communication and runtime
> resources for TypeScript and Rust participants. Native IDL generates each
> participant's typed API; connected calls run over NATS, and the libraries own
> bootstrap, proofs, authorization, and connection lifecycle.

Use the guides from the same Trellis release or checkout as the installed CLI
and libraries. In a checkout they live under `docs/static/`; raw GitHub links
address the main branch and may be newer than an installed release. They cover
Trellis interfaces, not application engineering policy: services choose their
configuration, databases, domain models, dependency injection, layout, and
tools.

## Guides

- [Trellis guide](llms-core.txt): project files and generation, running
  Trellis, identity and connection, authorization, accounts, communication
  surfaces, resources, platform APIs, and testing.
- [TypeScript](llms-typescript.txt): generated packages, service connection,
  handlers, events, operations and transfers, jobs, resources and the SQL
  outbox, browser apps, and the Node testkit.
- [Rust](llms-rust.txt): generated crates and features, connection options,
  native OAuth and devices, typed surfaces, resources and transfers, and the
  Rust testkit.
- [Svelte](llms-svelte.txt): browser authentication and the Svelte integration.
- [Complete guide](llms-full.txt): all of the above in one file.

## Human Documentation

- Service walkthrough: `/guides/write-a-service`.
- IDL authoring: `/guides/authoring-contracts`.
- Testing: `/guides/testing-trellis-services`.
- Installing and running Trellis: `/guides/install-trellis`,
  `/guides/starting-trellis`.
- Public API reference: `/api`. Generated participant source defines the exact
  names available for a project's declared actions.

## Optional

- [Consumer AGENTS templates](templates/): the Trellis boundary for a service
  repository's `AGENTS.md`; application policies belong in that repository.
